# Anaxia 3.4.1rc1 — exact seed intervals and visual certificate explorer

This research candidate independently verifies twelve explicit reflexive subpolytopes. Relative to the supplied Kreuzer–Skarke point-pair census, it improves the maximum shortest-descent upper bound from 348 to 346. The prior 22 lower bound and 348 arbitrary-descent bound are retained; the exact D4 is open.

The interval lemma supplies genuine covers without assuming that the proposed cut itself is a cover. The checker reconstructs exact geometry, polar point sets, interval costs and census coverage, and uses determinant spectra to distinguish the two equal-count representatives. A responsive offline explorer and animated README preview display the retained data.

Hodge messages now distinguish motivated classes from constructed algebraic cycles, include established split-Weil cases, and treat 31 eight-bundle graph survivors as necessary candidates. No Hodge representative, semiregular object, all-nine-condition GSC vacuum or continuum Yang–Mills construction has been produced. The full closure benchmark has not been crossed.

Validation and any unavailable release checks are recorded with the release assets. No new Lean proof or DOI is asserted before the corresponding checks or archival response exists.
